description: Orunyankore lwogerwa abantu nga obukadde busatu mu Ankole, ensozi eziri ku luuyi lw’obugwanjuba bwa Uganda okwetooloola Mbarara, ensi y’ente ez’amayembe amawanvu.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Runyankore courses (#128); needs a native-speaker review. The Luganda needs a native-speaker review; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/nyn).

why.title: Olulimi lw’**ensozi n’ente za Ankole.**
why.text: Orunyankore lwe lulimi lw’e Mbarara, Bushenyi, Ntungamo ne Ibanda, era lufaanana Olukiga, Olunyoro n’Olutooro, kale okuluyiga kukuggulawo ebitundu bingi eby’obugwanjuba bwa Uganda. Luyige olw’ab’omu maka, okutambula, emirimu n’ebitontome bya Ankole.

cards.title: Eri ab’omu maka
cards.text: Yogera ne bajjajja n’ab’eŋŋanda mu bugwanjuba bwa Uganda.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Mbarara okutuuka ku Nnyanja Mburo ne Kabale.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula ebika by’amannya, okulamusa okuwanvu n’ebigambo bingi eby’ente.

landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’omu maka abava mu Ankole, n’abatambuze abagenda mu bugwanjuba bwa Uganda.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okwennyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, essaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Orunyankore nga tannaba kutambula
